data.explanation: This is the second reminder about an unpaid internet/phone bill. To avoid a service block, pay the total of €49.99 to the account shown so that it arrives by the date given in the letter. If your payment already crossed with this letter, you can treat it as settled. If you think this charge is wrong, contact NetzMuster GmbH directly using the contact details on the letter before the deadline. Keep proof of any payment you make in case of a later dispute.
